The strange book from Valeera’s library now remains still, apart from its eye, it looks like an ordinary old book. Most of its pages have decayed and tattered only leaving a few stories intact. 

The founder of Summoning magic, Eggret, felt an unprecedented crisis in his late years due to the threat of chaos and thus began the research of the most complex subject of all— using magic to create a similar world in order to provide a better place for future generations to live in forever.

5200001.name: Lucky Goldfish
5200001.description: Every instance of damage taken will not surpass 30% of self Maximum HP (The amount of damage reduced will not exceed 100% of the owner's Maximum HP. This effect can only be triggered 3 times per Round).

5200002.name: Floating Jellyfish
5200002.description: In battle, the owner of this set gains 0.5% Damage Reduction for every 1% Crit Resist she has. When she takes a Critical Strike from Basic Attacks or Active Skills, she will gain 30% Crit Resist that lasts for 1 Round.

5200003.name: Rock Crab
5200003.description:
At the start of the Round, the owner of the Set gains 1 stack of Carapace that lasts for 1 round.

Carapace: A Skill Effect.
Whenever the owner of this Effect takes damage, she will consume 1 stack of Carapace to nullify the damage.

5200004.name: Ghostly Goat
5200004.description: For every 3 instances of damage dealt, the owner of the Set will deal 60% more damage in the next instance of damage she deals.

5200005.name: Fiery Qilin
5200005.description: Increases damage dealt to enemies with more than 80% HP by 40%.

5200006.name: Cunning Lizard
5200006.description: Increases damage dealt to Boss enemies by 50%.

5200007.name: Nine-Tailed Fox
5200007.description: At the end of the round, if the owner of the Set dealt a Basic Attack or were unable to attack in the round, all allies will gain 15% Block and 15% Control Immunity that lasts for 2 rounds.

5200008.name: Weaver Kitty
5200008.description: Increase the amount of BP gained by 25%. When the owner of this Set releases her Active Skill, if she is protected by a [c][e28002]Magick Barrier[-][/c], her ally with the lowest HP will gain a [c][e28002]Magick Barrier[-][/c] with (20% of the ally's Maximum HP) BP.

5200009.name: Majestic Phoenix
5200009.description: Increase Heal Amount by 25%. When the owner of this Set is healed, 1 random Debuff (Damage Over Time, Attribute Reduction, Mark, Control Effect) will be removed from 1 random ally (This effect can only be triggered once per Round).
